tenderSchedule.title: Providing and supplying memento service to programmes organized by various Dasara Committee of Shivamogga Dasara 2026.
tenderSchedule.description: Providing and supplying memento service to programmes organized by various Dasara Committee of Shivamogga Dasara 2026.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The rates quoted by the tenderer should be inclussive of all taxes.
All other conditions as per tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All other documents as per tender document
Firm Registered Proprietor, Partnership, Public Sector or Private limited Company certificate
Minimum financial turnover with UDIN not less than the estimated cost of this tender, from the annual payments for any 1 year in last 5 years
Tenderer in his name should have provided at least one similar service in any state level dasara event, certificate should be signed by Executive Engineer or equivalent authority.
Tenderer in his name should have turnover in last 5 financial years period i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26 with UDIN number.

itemList.itemName: Designing, Providing and supplying of special Momento for VIPs of size having minimum length of 12 inch varying up to 15 inch and minimum height of 12 inches varying up to 15 inches and 3 to 5 inches thick made up of MDF new wood base or any good quality wooden base upon it Idol of elephant / Chamundeshwari devi / Ambari / Bhudda/ Mahaveera or any innovative design covered with transparent glass cover and printed sticker along with recyclable carry bag.

Designing, Providing and supplying of Momento of size having minimum length of 8 inch varying up to 15 inch and minimum height of 8 inches varying up to 15 inches and 3 to 5 inches thick made up of MDF new wood base and background support made up of wood or Acrylic material or any other suitable good quality material upon it elephant / Chamundeshwari devi / Ambari/any innovative design embossed with marble dust / powder with pigment and printed sticker along with recyclable carry bag.
